source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
Whenever this unit returns to the battlefield through [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush), the usual rules apply, and also:

- every model in it must be wholly within 9" of any battlefield edge
- a model of the unit must touch a [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) marker of yours, which is then removed

Where that is impossible, the unit cannot return to the battlefield this way.
